input.content: Validate a complete deterministic Paper-to-Video-to-Paper workflow trace.

ideal: The ordered trace begins with external intent, correlates distinct normalized Paper and Video origins through discovery, capability, calls, and results, keeps derivation external, requires a human decision before mutation, proves persisted audit, and ends with disable then zero fresh inventory.
criteria: Pass only through the shipped ordered-trace validator with exact evidence IDs, origin correlation, decision order, persistence marker, and kill-switch sequence.
limitations: Native WebMCP discovery and the complete workflow across public Paper and Video deployments are unproven.
Target-browser persistence, network, console, and post-disable fresh-session evidence are unproven.

input.content: Enable the shipped Paper and Video registrations, then use both kill switches.

ideal: The production controller classes register the actual main-file tool compositions, expose active only after successful registration, propagate lifecycle signals, disable all four tools, and leave both controllers disabled.
criteria: Pass only through PaperRegistrationController and VideoRegistrationController constructed from existing Paper and Video tool factories; mocked native registration is a local seam and is not public discovery evidence.
limitations: Native WebMCP discovery and the complete workflow across public Paper and Video deployments are unproven.
Target-browser persistence, network, console, and post-disable fresh-session evidence are unproven.
